methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Landingi's official page renders prices client-side (JS-only); prices were sourced from GetApp and corroborated by SoftwareAdvice (both reputable 2026 aggregators). Swipe Pages shows only annual-billed prices on its pricing page; monthly billing equivalents were reverse-calculated from stated annual savings figures. Carrd prices are annual-only; monthlyUsd reflects the annualized monthly rate. Leadpages annual discount of 20% is published on their pricing page; annual monthly-equivalent prices are derived from that discount. Instapage annual discount approximated at ~20% based on published savings language; exact annual rates not precisely stated. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null as this is a non-telephony vertical.
